checked: Royce pp. 788-789 (full text): Superintendent Beale establishes Tejon Pass reserve; surveyed at about 75,000 acres; Secretary ordered reduction to 25,000 acres on Nov. 25, 1856 under the Act of Mar. 3, 1855; Beale and others obtained patents under old Spanish grants; last Indians removed to Tule River per Wiley, July 11, 1864. All match.

United States v. Title Insurance and Trust Co., 265 U.S. 472 (Cornell LII): the opinion says the grant was made by Mexico in 1843 and does not name Tejon, as the file says; it went against the Indians in any case.
No-breach status is consistent with the 2026-11-08 rule on executive reserves; no court or Commission finding about this reserve was located (ICC title search for Tejon: none).
unverifiable: Royce gives no day; the 1853-09-01 date is a placeholder, as the file says.
